findings.claim: The observed window is the score-time grid 0.0-0.49 with learning window [0.0,0.5]; recorded affinities were removed and an equal score prior applies, so no absolute affinity target is available in the supplied evidence.

The declared objective is final predicted target affinity primary with validity and strain secondary under coordinate-only control; the reward view is the endpoint pointcloud with a detached Hungarian endpoint mean squared distance and native endpoint VJP, so coordinate contrasts are not physical interaction energies.

Curve support selected 24 features under a rule requiring absolute integrated z >= 0.1, batch direction fraction >= 0.857, exclusion of a scale floor and q < 0.05, with a fidelity rule of relative RMSE <= 0.35, zero strong sign-conflict nodes and quiet-node large-fit fraction <= 0.1; the per-feature fidelity audit is stored as a container summary and was not read numerically.

Independent-batch audit over 14 batches shows compressed-choice excess fixed-frame RMS of about 0.081 A (CI95 ~0.070-0.092) and compressed-choice fixed RMS of about 0.564 A (CI95 ~0.499-0.620), with proper-rigid RMS about 0.529 A; the excess is nonnegative by construction and is not a causal affinity effect.

Teacher-score correlations of chosen candidates are weak (compressed ~0.102, full ~0.064) and are observational, not a fitted or independently validated affinity predictor; top4 teacher overlap is about 0.47.

Lineage support covers 14 complete-survival batches over 700 batch nodes, but 349 nodes have fewer than 3 ancestors and 531 have fewer than 6, and multiple testing is BH jointly over 400 survival field/measure tests that are explicitly not terminal affinity effects; terminal metadata shows a single future-resampling node per batch at terminal score time 0.99 and state time 1.0, outside the observed window.

hypotheses.direction: favor coordinates whose signed contrast is favorable versus comparison at observed nodes
hypotheses.falsifier: a validated fit showing no sign change or a strong sign conflict at the selected nodes, or batch direction fraction below the selection threshold
hypotheses.observable: signed coordinate contrast at observed selection nodes over [0.0,0.49]
hypotheses.scope: observed score window only; no extrapolation beyond 0.49
hypotheses.statement: Signed favorable-versus-comparison coordinate contrasts at observed selection nodes over the complete observed window can be expressed as a time-conditioned regional attention recipe using the same static teachers, changing regional attention at observed score nodes without introducing a velocity target.

hypotheses.direction: treat selection enrichment as descriptive, not as an affinity reward target
hypotheses.falsifier: decoded terminal labels showing that the excess tracks final affinity benefit
hypotheses.observable: compressed-choice excess fixed-frame RMS and its batch bootstrap CI
hypotheses.statement: Selection enrichment (excess fixed-frame RMS relative to a compressed choice) is a geometric descriptor of the chosen candidate set and should not be presented as final affinity benefit, because terminal labels are not decoded and last-record credit is not final affinity.

limitations: Recorded affinities were removed and an equal score prior applies; no absolute affinity target or decoded terminal label is available, so final affinity benefit cannot be evaluated from the supplied evidence.
The per-feature curve fidelity audit is a container summary; its numeric contents were not read, so per-feature fit fidelity and sign-change counts are not asserted.

The information audit explicitly states its metrics are not the full score-weighted reward or its FLOWR Jacobian, and that teacher score correlations are observational rather than a validated affinity predictor.
Survival and turnover multiple testing is not terminal affinity effects; last-record credit and survival credit are not final affinity benefit.
No current study outcome data are supplied to the design roles, so no outcome-based ranking or causal selection claim is made.
